test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Change the sentence from direct speech to indirect speech:

She said, “Don’t the children like the cake?”

options.text: She asked whether the children liked the cake.
She wondered why the children didn’t like the cake.
she asked me whether the children didn’t like the cake.
She enquired about whether the children liked the cake.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She asked me whether the children didn’t like the cake.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Don’t the children like" becomes "whether the children didn’t like"**
 
 
• The question "Don’t the children like" is converted to the indirect speech format "whether the children didn’t like".
 
• The pronoun "the children" remains the same in indirect speech.
 
• The verb tense is adjusted to fit indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting clause:**
 
 
• Direct: She said
 
• Converted to: She asked me, adding the reporting clause for indirect questioning.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Indirect speech does not require quotation marks.
 
• Ensures proper punctuation and format for readability.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She asked me whether the children didn’t like the cake."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She asked whether the children liked the cake."

 
 
• The question is changed to a positive form, losing the original negative question.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She wondered why the children didn’t like the cake."
 
 
• Changes the verb from "asked" to "wondered", altering the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She enquired about whether the children liked the cake."
 
 
• Uses the verb "enquired" instead of "asked" and changes the structure, making it less direct.
